cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I circled that restaurant on the map like you did. Just admit I found dinner; you can have the rest of the holiday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My circle marked where we shouldn't eat. It was shut.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, ruling places out. Admit I saved us a wasted walk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We walked there because you insisted. Your map was useless; I found dinner next door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then dinner's yours. Withdraw 'useless'; that map got us to the street with the open restaurant.

reason: Give S04 a particular misunderstood imitation which changes the Drive tactic. Preserve responsive B turns and explicitly stated essential facts; remove generic confidence prefaces.
